$comment: Locates the upstream Docusaurus docs repo (OffchainLabs/arbitrum-docs) and pins the comparison
window, so a multi-day sync is not chasing a moving target while upstream keeps committing.
Resolution order used by scripts/lib/upstream-tree.mjs: --tree-a flag, then UPSTREAM_DOCS_REPO env
var, then `repo` below, then sibling-directory probes. When none resolves, the drift scripts print
and exit 0 so CI stays green without an upstream checkout; pass --require-tree-a to make it fatal.
This file is checked in on purpose: .gitignore excludes .env*, so an env-file default could not be
shared, which is why a machine-specific absolute path was hardcoded in upstream-drift.mjs before.

portWindow.$comment: Upstream commits bracketing the migration port waves (2026-07-13/14). Pinned 2026-08-17.
